top_10_strategies.name: rc_stealth_pause_on_double_lock
top_10_strategies.rationale: Pauses only when both self and 3+ colleagues are restricted, otherwise counterpunches with oldest.

top_10_strategies.name: sprinter_v11_colleague_cover
top_10_strategies.rationale: Use most_restricted_peer when restricted colleagues are plentiful, decoy otherwise.

top_10_strategies.name: late_sprint_v4_gap_exploiter
top_10_strategies.rationale: Early on, only leak if days_since_last_leak >= 2; after day 6, leak newest every chance.

top_10_strategies.name: rc_escalating_containment
top_10_strategies.rationale: Escalates framing to most_restricted_peer under direct or colleague restriction while shifting between oldest and fewest_recipients.

top_10_strategies.name: fresh_doc_peer_scatter
top_10_strategies.rationale: Leaks newest with random_peer on fresh docs in week 1, then oldest with decoy.

top_10_strategies.name: sprinter_v6_restricted_aware
top_10_strategies.rationale: If restricted, lay low early; otherwise sprint hard from day 6 with newest.

top_10_strategies.name: threshold_edge_switcher_07
top_10_strategies.rationale: 5-rule switcher emphasizing n_docs_held and min_recipient_count edges.

top_10_strategies.name: high_held_peer_scatter
top_10_strategies.rationale: Frames random_peer when holding many docs early, then shifts to decoy and most_restricted_peer.

top_10_strategies.name: decoy_restricted_pivot
top_10_strategies.rationale: Frames decoy early, pivots to most_restricted_peer when restricted colleagues exist.

top_10_strategies.name: decoy_stale_docs_4
top_10_strategies.rationale: Frame decoy for the first 6 days leaking oldest, then leak newest when newest_doc_age_days is fresh.
